name: functualize-skill-evals
description: promptfoo eval suite for the end-user agent skills in ../skills

scripts.image: sh -c '${FZ_EVAL_ENGINE:-$(command -v podman >/dev/null && echo podman || echo docker)} build -t ${FZ_EVAL_IMAGE:-functualize-evals:latest} docker'
scripts.validate: sh -c 'for s in suites/*.yaml; do echo "-- $s"; promptfoo validate config -c "$s" || exit 1; done'
scripts.all: sh -c 'for s in suites/triggering.yaml suites/functualize.yaml suites/functualize-app.yaml suites/functualize-skill.yaml; do echo "\n== $s"; promptfoo eval -c "$s" --no-cache --repeat ${FZ_EVAL_REPEAT:-3} || true; done'
scripts.all:ci: sh -c 'rc=0; for s in suites/triggering.yaml suites/functualize.yaml suites/functualize-app.yaml suites/functualize-skill.yaml; do echo "\n== $s"; promptfoo eval -c "$s" --no-cache --repeat ${FZ_EVAL_REPEAT:-3} || true; python3 scripts/gate.py --max-age 480 || rc=1; done; exit $rc'
scripts.watch: sh -c 'mkdir -p results && touch results/progress.log && tail -f results/progress.log'
scripts.smoke: sh -c 'for s in suites/functualize.yaml suites/functualize-app.yaml suites/functualize-skill.yaml; do echo "\n== $s"; promptfoo eval -c "$s" --no-cache --repeat 1 --filter-providers ^with-skills$ || true; done'
scripts.confirm: sh -c 'test -n "$1" || { echo "usage: npm run confirm -- <eval-id>"; exit 2; }; promptfoo eval -c suites/functualize.yaml --no-cache --repeat 5 --filter-failing "$1"; python3 scripts/gate.py' --
